Your knight on e1 is trapped but not lost—it can capture the rook! After Nxf3, White must recapture with the f-pawn. Your knight then gives check on h2, forking the king and the bishop on g4. The king moves, and you win the bishop. Look for "trapped" pieces that can deliver a forcing blow against an undefended attacker—they may turn the tables completely.
